description: Six 8x8 stamps in one sheet: dirt, dirt variant, grass-over-dirt, grass variant, ore, ore variant. Edges match within one ramp step. Grass is a real layer boundary (top grass, bottom dirt) so the vertical seam is exempt. Ore sits in the interior.
source_note: Terralistic base_game/resources/blocks/Template_grass_block.png, first cell of the strip
